name: A Tale of Two Lovers
source:
A Tale of Two Lovers is a visual novel game for adults only. This game is about two young lovers who like to fuck each other after the day's rush. These guys know how to have sex and fuck every day after work!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2451630/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
两个恋人的故事是一款仅供成人使用的视觉小说游戏。这款游戏讲述了两个年轻恋人在一天的忙碌之后喜欢互相操的故事。这些家伙每天下班后都知道如何做爱和做爱！

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2451630/]Steam[/url]]
